description_en: Modifies a Connector instance under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号下Connector实例
name: UpdateConnector

parameters.help_en: The Connector ID. You can obtain the value by calling [ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~)
parameters.name: connector_id

parameters.help_en: The Connector name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: Connector名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The instance status of the Connector. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
Connector实例状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: switch_status

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Global Accelerator. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用全球加速。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: accelerate_status

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the virtual IP address
parameters.name: vip_cidr
